refusalCases.paperReason: Exactly one supplied raw draw is required; zero-level arithmetic does not waive that requirement.
Two supplied records are refused rather than silently leaving one unused.
The rawDraws field must be a singleton array.
A singleton list containing a number is not a draw object.
The supplied role is not debate-hp-damage-jitter.
The required bound is exactly 5.
An integer draw below 0 is outside the supported jitter domain.
An integer draw equal to bound 5 is outside the supported jitter domain.
Fractional numbers are refused during safe detachment, before field-specific draw-value parsing.
Closed draw objects do not accept a seed field.
Non-identity/person-specific post-formula behavior is not modeled.
